summary: The Tenant has several obligations, including paying a monthly rent of Rs. 18,000 on or before the 5th day of every month, and must not vacate the flat during the first six months of the tenancy. The Tenant is also restricted from subletting or sharing the flat without written consent from the Landlord. Maintenance charges must be paid as decided by the Landlord from time to time, and the rent is scheduled to increase by 5 percent at the end of every 11 months. The Tenant may end the agreement after the lock-in period by providing two months' written notice to the Landlord, and a penalty may be applied if the rent is not paid by the due date.
